item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows two cloth samples of the same thickness in sunlight: a white sample and a black sample. Vihaan packs for a hot sunny afternoon and for a cold winter morning.

Answer both parts.

options.text: Choose the white sample idea for the hot afternoon because light-coloured cloth reflects more of the heat that falls on it; choose the black sample idea for the cold morning because dark-coloured cloth absorbs more heat.
Choose the black sample idea for the hot afternoon and the white sample idea for the cold morning.
Even with no sunlight on either sample, the black sample still gains more heat from its colour alone.
The black sample reflects more heat than the white sample because black looks stronger.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.
